answer: PoA resists Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral and linking signatures to an accountable escrow. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting histories, correlated-fault detection aggregates their penalties at O(k^2), rather than treating violations independently. Upon detection, a swarm also triggers an exponential multiplier on capital loss, compounded through asymmetric depreciation, so opal, nectar, and summit reserves cannot cheaply finance replication or recovery.
